proof.source: The physical LTYPE XDATA sequence is bound to its APPID. Each POINT target is uniquely identified by source handle, physical section, block-record owner, parsed callback, exact DRW_Point dynamic type, position and default thickness/extrusion/axis-angle sentinels.
proof.output: For both source sections and all four encoding pairs, emitted physical XDATA is checked in order against the remapped POINT handle. The model-space target is emitted in ENTITIES under *Model_Space; the named target remains in BLOCKS under AuthorityBlock. Fresh typed readback verifies exact owner, POINT position and the selected POINT fields.
proof.failure_retry: For each section and encoding pair, removing the POINT target refuses export and preserves the prior destination; restoring it permits same-adapter retry. Separate late-mutation probes change the target handle after APPID emission in ENTITIES and BLOCKS; finalization refuses without replacing the destination, and restoring the original handle permits same-adapter retry with physical output and typed readback.
